items.title: Ike Robertson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: Bebe Ridgely was a good guy. Well, Bebe Ridgely was a pretty flat-clone move there.

ctx.x: still a Celestan, all good man. All good man.

Well, how was Bebe Ridgely in the old days? I never got to hear him except on some records. You can't hear so well on those records that are, uh... Well, when he, when him and Sonny was together. Yeah, in those old days, how did he play? Well, Bebe Ridgely was a good guy. Well, Bebe Ridgely was a pretty flat-clone move there.
Tomorrow he doesn't, anyway. But after him and Celestan bust up, he went... He had his own band, huh? Had his own band.
